summary: Exelixis filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on September 10, 2026 the FDA extended by three months the review period for its NDA for zanzalintinib plus atezolizumab in metastatic colorectal cancer. The FDA deemed Exelixis's updated safety and efficacy data, submitted after an agency information request, a major amendment, moving the Prescription Drug User Fee Act action date to March 3, 2027. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are stated. This is a regulatory milestone update, not a special situation; watch the new PDUFA date and any further FDA correspondence.
